query: I have three independent tasks: fix the CSS regression in the dashboard header, add input validation to the /api/users endpoint, and update the README with the new environment variables. None of these touch the same files. Can we work on all three at once?

Our test suite has 4 failing test files — test/auth.test.ts, test/billing.test.ts, test/notifications.test.ts, and test/search.test.ts. They all have different root causes. The auth test has a mock issue, billing has a decimal precision bug, notifications has a timing problem, and search has a stale index. Can we fix them concurrently?

I need to update the logging format in the API gateway, refactor the error handling in the worker service, and add health check endpoints to the scheduler. These are three separate microservices with their own codebases in services/gateway, services/worker, and services/scheduler.

We have bugs in completely separate subsystems: the image upload pipeline is failing silently in src/upload/, the email template rendering is broken in src/email/, and the CSV export has encoding issues in src/export/. Let's tackle all three simultaneously since they don't share any state.

I want multiple agents working concurrently on these independent improvements: add TypeScript strict mode to the utils package, set up Storybook for the component library, and configure ESLint flat config for the monorepo root. Different packages, different configs, no overlap.

There are 5 independent Dockerfiles that need updating across our services — each one needs to be migrated from node:16 to node:20, update the build stage, and fix the healthcheck command. They're in separate directories and don't depend on each other.

I need to simultaneously create database migration scripts for three new tables: audit_logs, feature_flags, and api_keys. They have no foreign key relationships between them and can be developed independently.

Can we split up this work? The frontend needs a new date picker component in src/components/, the backend needs a new cron job in src/jobs/, and the infrastructure needs a new CloudFormation template in infra/. Completely separate domains.

Multiple CI config files need fixes: .github/workflows/test.yml has a caching issue, .github/workflows/deploy.yml has wrong environment variables, and .github/workflows/lint.yml is using a deprecated action. These are independent workflow files.

I want agents to work on these in parallel: write unit tests for the payment module in test/payment/, write integration tests for the auth module in test/auth/, and write e2e tests for the onboarding flow in test/e2e/. Each test suite is self-contained.

I need to refactor the user authentication flow. The login, token refresh, and session management are all tightly coupled in src/auth/session.ts and need to be carefully updated together to avoid breaking the auth state machine.
Can you run the full test suite and give me a summary of what passed and what failed? Just run npm test and parse the output for me.

I need to add pagination to the /api/products endpoint. It needs cursor-based pagination with a default page size of 20, and the response format needs to include total count, next cursor, and previous cursor.
The database migration in migrations/042_add_indexes.sql failed halfway through. Some indexes were created and some weren't. I need to figure out which ones succeeded and write a recovery migration.

Can you help me understand the data flow through our event processing pipeline? I want to trace how a single event goes from the API gateway through the message queue to the worker and finally to the database.

I have a sequence of dependent tasks: first update the database schema, then regenerate the ORM models, then update the API handlers to use the new models, and finally update the tests. Each step depends on the previous one.

We need to parallelize our database queries in the reporting endpoint. Right now it runs 6 queries sequentially but they could use Promise.all since they read from different tables. Update src/reports/quarterly.ts.
Help me set up a parallel test runner for our integration tests. I want to use Jest's --maxWorkers flag and configure test isolation so the database tests don't interfere with each other.

The build is failing because of a circular dependency between src/models/user.ts and src/models/organization.ts. They both import from each other and TypeScript can't resolve the types. Help me break the cycle.

I need to dispatch events from the order service to multiple downstream consumers — inventory, shipping, and billing. Help me implement the event dispatch pattern in src/events/dispatcher.ts using our RabbitMQ setup.
